Requires at least 10 prior runs for the model. Torrix calculates your average daily cost from the current month's runs and extrapolates it to the end of the month. The forecast is color-coded: green when on track, amber when approaching your budget, and red when the projection exceeds it. No extra configuration is needed beyond setting a budget in Settings.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003ePer-project and per-key budget limits\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-per-project-and-per-key-budget-limits\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Per-project and per-key budget limits\" href=\"#per-project-and-per-key-budget-limits\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eIn addition to the global daily cap, you can set a daily spending limit scoped to an individual project or API key. Go to \u003cstrong\u003eSettings \u0026gt; Budget and Sampling\u003c/strong\u003e and use the Per-project and Per-key Limits card to add a cap. Select a project or API key from the dropdown, enter the daily limit in USD, then click Add.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eWhen a proxy request arrives with \u003ccode\u003ex-torrix-project: \u0026lt;name\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e and that project has already reached its daily cap, Torrix returns a 429 before making the upstream call:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"{\u0026quot;error\u0026quot;: \u0026quot;Project budget cap exceeded\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;detail\u0026quot;: \u0026quot;Daily cap of $0.50 reached for this project.\u0026quot;}\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e{\u003cspan class=\"pl-ent\"\u003e\"error\"\u003c/span\u003e: \u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eProject budget cap exceeded\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e, \u003cspan class=\"pl-ent\"\u003e\"detail\"\u003c/span\u003e: \u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eDaily cap of $0.50 reached for this project.\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e}\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003ePer-key limits work the same way using the API key that authenticates the request. The global hard cap and per-scope limits are checked independently, so whichever limit is reached first takes effect.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eStreaming instrumentation\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-streaming-instrumentation\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Streaming instrumentation\" href=\"#streaming-instrumentation\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eStreaming responses (requests sent with \u003ccode\u003e\"stream\": true\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003eAccept: text/event-stream\u003c/code\u003e) are fully instrumented with no added latency. Torrix accumulates SSE chunks while piping them to your client in real time. When the stream closes, each run is backfilled with:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eModel name, input and output token counts, and cost\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eFull response text saved as a RESPONSE event in the timeline\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eChain-of-thought reasoning saved as a THINKING event (Kimi K2, DeepSeek R1, Qwen3, and similar thinking models that emit \u003ccode\u003edelta.reasoning\u003c/code\u003e chunks)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eTool calls saved as TOOL CALL events, identical to non-streaming tool call tracing\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eSupported formats: OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, NVIDIA, Together, Ollama) and Anthropic. NVIDIA-hosted models that send usage in a dedicated final chunk (e.g. Kimi K2.5, DeepSeek R1) are fully supported.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eThinking \u0026amp; reasoning capture\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-thinking--reasoning-capture\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Thinking \u0026amp; reasoning capture\" href=\"#thinking--reasoning-capture\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eCaptures chain-of-thought reasoning from OpenAI o1/o3/o4, DeepSeek R1, Claude extended thinking, Gemini 2.5, Ollama Qwen3, and Kimi K2. Reasoning steps appear in the Event Timeline alongside the final response. Works for both standard and streaming requests. Reasoning tokens are tracked separately where the model reports them.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eRun scoring and LLM judge\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-run-scoring-and-llm-judge\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Run scoring and LLM judge\" href=\"#run-scoring-and-llm-judge\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eRate any run good or bad manually with a thumbs up or down, or let an AI judge evaluate it automatically.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eManual scoring:\u003c/strong\u003e Click the thumbs up or thumbs down button on any run detail page. Add an optional note to record why.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAuto-score with AI judge:\u003c/strong\u003e Click \u003cstrong\u003eAuto-score with AI\u003c/strong\u003e on the run detail page. The judge evaluates:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003ePrompt quality: clarity, specificity, and whether it follows LLM best practices\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eResponse correctness, helpfulness, and appropriate detail level\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eToken and latency efficiency: whether usage is proportionate to the task complexity\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eReasoning depth (for runs with chain-of-thought): whether the thinking effort matches the task\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eSelect a provider (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic), paste your API key, optionally set a custom model or base URL, and click \u003cstrong\u003eAuto-score\u003c/strong\u003e. Configure your judge provider and API key once in \u003cstrong\u003eSettings \u0026gt; AI Judge\u003c/strong\u003e and Torrix stores it securely for all evaluations. In the run detail panel, use \u003cstrong\u003eUse Judge LLM\u003c/strong\u003e to score with the saved key, or switch to \u003cstrong\u003eManual\u003c/strong\u003e to enter credentials inline for a one-off evaluation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eBatch scoring:\u003c/strong\u003e On the Runs page, use the \u003cstrong\u003eBatch auto-score\u003c/strong\u003e panel to score multiple runs at once with one click. Saves your judge settings across sessions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOnline Evals (Pro):\u003c/strong\u003e Enable per project in \u003cstrong\u003eSettings \u0026gt; Online Evals\u003c/strong\u003e to automatically score every incoming production run as it arrives. The AI judge runs in the background after each new run is logged. Judge eval costs are tracked separately under \u003cstrong\u003eAnalytics\u003c/strong\u003e and do not affect your production LLM spend figures.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eFiltering and export:\u003c/strong\u003e Use the Score filter on the Runs page to show only good, bad, or unscored runs.
